comments.author: ninethirty
comments.story: Ask HN: Is your memory as bad as mine?
comments.why: Example of expert memory built on care and context.
comments.text: Not enough context. Do you only watch football once every four years? Probably you don't care enough and have enough context of strategic moments to create memories. The more you care + context, the better the memory will be, see LeBron + Magnus. { [LINK] , [VIDEO] }

comments.author: lysp
comments.why: Carlsen identifies players, tournaments and next moves from positions.
comments.text: I saw a video a while ago. [VIDEO] They put a number of mid-game positions on the board, and Magnus was able to guess the players, tournament, game number, who won, what the next few moves were. Who was playing on the table next to him. What their moves were.
